# Part B Optimizer

> De-identified Medicare plan comparison platform that models Original Medicare + Medigap vs. Medicare Advantage under 2026 and 2027 federal rules. No personally identifiable information is collected — scenarios use only year of birth and ZIP3.

Part B Optimizer lets consumers build a private Medicare scenario in about two minutes and receive a shareable Scenario ID they can hand to the licensed agent of their choice. Scenarios auto-delete after 90 days.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the zero-PII Medicare scenario model and how it works.
- [Build a Scenario](/scenario/new): Create a de-identified Medicare scenario and get a Scenario ID.

- [Beta NDA](/nda): Non-disclosure agreement for staff and beta testers.
